name: repair
title: rosync repair
description: Checks live tree access, rebuilds generated metadata, and repairs startup-blocking disk projection conflicts.
usage:
rosync repair tree [--project <path>] [--port <port>] [--depth <n>] [--raw]
rosync repair sourcemap [--project <path>] [--output <path>] [--raw]
rosync repair projection [--project <path>] [--raw]
rosync repair projection --project <path> --resolve <conflict-or-recovery-id> [--keep <exact-filename|quarantine>] [--raw]
notes: `repair tree` validates that the live Studio tree can be read; use `rosync tree` or `rosync query` to inspect it.
`repair sourcemap` rebuilds luau-lsp sourcemap JSON from synced service folders.
`repair projection` is fully offline: it does not start a daemon or contact Roblox Studio.
Raw reports include `countsKnown`; callers must require `countsKnown: true`, `truncated: false`, and zero conflicts before treating the projection as proven clean.
Inspection previews every conflicting init source with a bounded source preview, size, class, and SHA-256 hash. Ro Sync never guesses a winner.
Resolution rescans the project and rejects stale conflict IDs. Unselected marker files are moved into `.rosync-backups`; they are never deleted.
Before the UI inspects or resolves a blocker, it removes the project from persisted desired-serving state so desktop health checks and Terminal 64 startup cannot retry behind the repair panel.

macOS and Linux resolution uses held directory handles and atomic no-replace renames. Windows currently supports offline inspection but fails closed before mutation until the equivalent handle-relative resolver is available.

Every resolution writes durable prepared/committed receipts under `.rosync-backups`. An uncertain transaction returns `recoveryRequired`, reports whether the receipt path was proven through `receiptAvailable`, advertises supported `recoveryActions`, and blocks daemon startup across reloads.

Resolving a recovery ID without `--keep` securely replays the recorded decision after re-proving the receipt, kept source, and every source/destination hash. Ambiguous both-or-neither states remain blocked.

`--keep quarantine` is an explicit last-resort recovery action for an unreplayable transaction record. It moves only that transaction directory out of the active recovery prefix, never edits source files, and still requires a complete clean projection scan before serving.
Legacy literal filenames in the reserved init-marker grammar are renamed to their escaped disk spelling without changing script source or the Roblox instance name.
